thread.title: Bloomberg sources offer Apple WWDC preview - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Bloomberg sources offer Apple WWDC preview - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple’s (NASDAQ: AAPL ) Worldwide Developers Conference kicks off on Monday and Bloomberg sources offer a peek at what the tech giant could reveal at the event.
Digital Health: A series of tools meant to monitor how much time users spend on their devices and within specific apps. The data will appear in the Settings app to offer ways for the user to prevent overuse. (Google’s new Dashboard for Android serves a similar function.)
AR: The new ARKit 2.0 software will include a new mode allowing users to play AR games against each other in a shared virtual environment while another mode allows for objects to be dropped into the environment and stay in place. Apple could release an AR headset as early as 2020.
Macs: Mac software will get an update for better integration with iOS.
Apple shares are up 0.03% to $187.55.
